assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: One standalone background environment PNG layer for an interactive POV wedding invitation.
Primary request: A first-person view inside a crooked little cottage vestibule, facing an EMPTY OPEN DOORWAY centered in the image. A quiet morning garden is visible beyond.
Style/medium: Don't Starve Together visual style, angular crooked cut-paper objects, extremely bold scratchy black ink contours, expressive scribbled crosshatching, simple flat muted sepia and cream with small dusty maroon accents. Whimsical gothic storybook game art. Use broad shapes, not intricate realistic engraving.
Composition: Portrait canvas exactly 1024 x 1536. Eye level, looking straight forward. Doorway interior occupies roughly x28%–72%, y12%–74% of the canvas; the vertical doorway sides must be nearly parallel/straight for a separately animated door leaf overlay. Doorway is open and unobstructed: NO door leaf anywhere. Cream-morning garden beyond the opening with simple angular hedge/tree silhouettes and a path. Foreground wooden floor occupies bottom quarter. Only at edges of room: narrow side window with simple curtain, partial little furniture edges; room should feel close and small. Door opening is dominant center shape. Opaque illustrated background, not transparency.
Palette: warm gray cream, muted sepia, charcoal brown and black, restrained maroon.
Constraints: One environment only, no storyboard, no panels, no screenshot, no UI, no words, no letters, no people, no characters, no hands, no envelope, no doors at all. Avoid photorealism, 3D, smooth gradients, polished vector art, detailed realistic engraving. Strong sparse crooked hand-drawn shapes.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: One standalone transparent PNG cutout layer, a wooden door leaf for an interactive gothic cottage wedding invitation.
Primary request: Isolated CLOSED wooden door LEAF seen perfectly FRONT-ON with parallel sides, approximately 1:2 width-to-height aspect. Very dark charcoal-brown vertical jagged wood planks, thick black ink outline, crooked subtle grain scratches and scribbled crosshatching, small tarnished brass handle on RIGHT side, two subtle hinge plates on LEFT. All of door visible; no crop.
Style/medium: Don't Starve Together game art. Angular cut-paper silhouette, bold scratchy black ink, sparse expressive scribbles, flat muted charcoal and sepia brown colors. Whimsical gothic, simple strong shapes, NOT realistic detailed engraving.
Composition: portrait 1024x1536 PNG canvas with door centered and its leaf occupying approx 65% of canvas width and 90% of height. The door leaf is a single solid near-rectangular flat wooden shape, with slightly irregular ink edge, suitable to scale into a rectangular door opening and rotate around its left edge.
Background: Actual transparent alpha channel, everything outside door must be fully transparent. No white matte, no black matte, no fake checkerboard pattern. Transparent cutout.
Constraints: ONE door leaf only. NO surrounding door frame, NO wall, NO room, NO garden, NO people, NO hands, NO letters, NO text, NO symbol on door, NO floor, NO ground shadow, no 3D perspective, no panels or storyboards. Flat front view only. Do not render a transparency checkerboard into pixels.

cleanup: Set only alpha 0–1 to fully transparent to remove numerical background speckles; preserve all other alpha.
Trim transparent padding tightly to the door leaf.

assets.prompt:

Primary request: POV adult hands wearing simple neutral IVORY sleeve cuffs extend diagonally inward from the BOTTOM LEFT and BOTTOM RIGHT corners and hold a LARGE CREAM ENVELOPE, seen FRONTALLY with very little perspective. Envelope in central image, horizontally rectangular, its top edge around y30% and bottom edge near y72%, covering x17%–83%. Thumb and fingertips hold only lower left and lower right corners. Warm pale tan skin, slender angular adult fingers. The closed envelope has a MAROON WAX SEAL at lower middle, subtle diagonal fold seams. Large upper central blank cream address area ABOVE THE SEAL must be totally EMPTY for live HTML guest-name text.
Style/medium: Don't Starve Together style game sprite. Angular crooked cut-paper shapes, bold scratchy black ink outlines, spare scribbled crosshatching, flat muted cream/sepia/maroon, whimsical gothic. Make hands stylized and simple, NOT photorealistic, NOT realistic detailed engraving. Envelope cream lightly mottled but empty and readable.
Composition: landscape 1536 x 1024 PNG. Same simple neutral ivory cuffs on both wrists. Envelope's front face parallel to image plane and large; hands/cuffs enter from bottom corners and crop naturally at bottom image edge. Keep space above envelope.
Background: Actual transparent alpha channel outside hands, sleeves and envelope. No backdrop, no solid color, no checkerboard texture. Clear transparent cutout.
Constraints: ONLY two hands with cuffs and ONE closed envelope, all other pixels transparent. NO body, NO face, NO room, NO table, NO floor, NO words, NO letters, NO address, NO logo, NO symbols on wax seal, NO patterned cuffs, NO jewelry. Five natural fingers per hand, no extra limbs.

cleanup: Set only alpha 0–1 to fully transparent to remove numerical background speckles; preserve all other alpha.
